# Final balanced-radius profile audit

All 40 frozen balanced-restart fits are included; raw-coordinate controls are outside this comparison. Each start is normalized by its own node RMS before averaging starts within a graph. Loss gaps are upper bounds on rank-24 suboptimality, relative to the unrestricted infimum; no arbitrary small-gap cutoff is imposed. Intermediate drift uses saved diagnostics, not reconstructed intermediate factors.

## Full-support unrestricted-target bounds

Only window ten has full positive support. These general bounds are supplementary: reaching the trivial normalized-profile bound is a failure to certify accuracy, not evidence of instability. The target is the unrestricted optimum, not the optimum under rank 24.
